what: A harness runs claude -p headless with the skill installed and records every tool call as a trace. Rule judges (side effects) and LLM judges (order, 'was the skill loaded') read the trace. Each failing judge's rationale is fed back to claude -p to fix SKILL.md, and the run repeats until every judge passes. A YAML config per test also covers 'must not trigger'. Repo mlflow/skills: 91 stars, Apache-2.0.
have: .claude/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md (output evals, benchmark, trigger optimizer); SkillSpector static scan (.planning/research/skillspector/); MLflow not installed

counterpart: customs step: SkillSpector static scan; skill-creator output evals
use: Before a skill is granted to an employee: a headless run (claude -p --setting-sources user) on a seeded job, judged over its JSONL transcript; a failing judge's rationale goes back as the fix request. The nearest row for testing our own dxb doors, which no row owns.
